subject: Picasso
date_notes: Folder name is the session date. Nine blocks carry a stem-date typo, mostly a New Year year-off-by-one. Two blocks start just after 00:00 UTC, i.e. the previous evening locally. See docs/notes/tdt_corpus.md.

tdt_stores.note: Which store is which anatomy is a rig-wiring fact and is NOT recorded in the tank. Unconfirmed: do not resolve geometry by array number until an operator confirms. Picasso additionally swaps which store acquires -- eNe1 through 2016-12-30, eNe2 for the 2017 blocks -- so the mapping matters here more than for Oops.

variants.base: online sortcode in the tsq: 0 and 1 only, an accept flag rather than a unit id
variants.sort/<name>/: offline OpenSorter result, one .SortResult per store, codes 1-2 with 31 as the outlier bin
